title: Beaumont Carnegie Library — historic exterior view (date unknown)
caption: Historic exterior view of the Beaumont Library District's Carnegie library building at 125 East 8th Street, Beaumont. The photograph's capture date is not identified in the available Calisphere image record.
description: An undated historical exterior photograph of Beaumont's Carnegie library building. The image is distinct from the modern view published with the Press-Enterprise's 2010 centennial article. The building opened in 1914, but that construction date does not establish when this photograph was taken.
